q.t: A football is shaped like a:
q.e: A sphere is round all over, just like a ball.

q.t: A dice is shaped like a:
q.e: A dice has 6 flat faces that are all the same square — that is a cube.

q.t: An empty ice-cream cone is shaped like a:
q.e: It is round at the top and comes to one pointed corner at the bottom — a cone.

q.t: A drum is shaped most like a:
q.e: A drum has two flat round faces and a curved side, like a cylinder.

q.t: A brick is shaped like a:
q.e: A brick is a box with 6 flat rectangle faces — a cuboid.

q.t: How many faces does a cube have?
q.e: Top, bottom, front, back, left and right — 6 faces.

q.t: How many corners does a sphere have?
q.e: A sphere is round all over, so no edges meet anywhere to make a corner.

q.t: Which shape can roll easily in every direction?
q.e: A sphere is curved everywhere, so it rolls whichever way you push it.

q.t: How many corners does a cone have?
q.e: A cone has just one pointed corner, at its tip.

q.t: A gift box is a cuboid. How many stars do you need to put one star on each face?
q.e: A cuboid has 6 faces, so it needs 6 stars.

q.t: How many edges does a cube have?
q.e: 4 edges round the top, 4 round the bottom and 4 standing up: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.

q.t: How many corners does a cuboid have?
q.e: 4 corners on the top face and 4 on the bottom face: 8.

q.t: How many flat faces does a cylinder have?
q.e: A cylinder has a flat circle at the top and one at the bottom; its side is curved.

q.t: Which shape has no corners and no edges?
q.e: A sphere has one smooth curved surface, so nothing meets to make an edge or a corner.

q.t: Which shape has exactly one corner?
q.e: The tip of a cone is its only corner.

q.t: A round clay matka (pot) is most like which shape?
q.e: A matka is round and fat all over, like a ball.

q.t: Which of these is NOT shaped like a cylinder?
q.e: A can, a pipe and a candle have flat round ends and a curved side; a football is round all over.

q.t: How is a harmonium (a box shape) different from a drum?
o: The harmonium has flat faces and corners; the drum has a curved side
The harmonium is round all over
The harmonium rolls like a drum
q.e: A box has only flat faces that meet at corners; a drum has a curved side and no corners.

q.t: Which shape can both roll and also stand still on a flat face?
q.e: On its curved side a cylinder rolls; stood on a flat end, it stays still.

q.t: A shehnai is narrow at one end and gets wider at the other end. It looks most like a:
q.e: A shape that widens from a narrow end is like a cone.

q.t: To put one ribbon on every edge of a cube-shaped box, how many ribbons do you need?
q.e: A cube has 12 edges, so one ribbon each makes 12.

q.t: You put one pompom on every corner of 2 cube boxes. How many pompoms in all?
q.e: Each cube has 8 corners, and 8 + 8 = 16.

q.t: You put one star on every face of 3 cubes. How many stars in all?
q.e: Each cube has 6 faces: 6 + 6 + 6 = 18.

q.t: Which is true about a cube and a cuboid?
o: Both have 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 corners
A cube has more corners than a cuboid
q.e: A cube is a special cuboid, so they have the same number of faces, edges and corners.

q.t: How are a cube and a cuboid different?
o: All faces of a cube are the same square; a cuboid’s faces can be longer rectangles
A cube can roll but a cuboid cannot
q.e: Both are boxes; in a cube every face is the same square.

q.t: Which shape has one curved face AND two flat faces?
q.e: A cylinder has a curved side and a flat circle at each end. A cone has only one flat face.

q.t: Which is the odd one out: a ball, an orange, a globe, a dice?
q.e: A ball, an orange and a globe are all spheres; a dice is a cube.

q.t: How many corners do one cone and one cube have together?
q.e: A cone has 1 corner and a cube has 8: 1 + 8 = 9.

q.t: How many edges does a sphere have?
q.e: An edge is where two faces meet. A sphere has only one smooth face, so it has no edges.

q.t: Which shape has zero corners but is NOT round all over?
q.e: A cylinder has no corners, yet it has flat ends. A sphere is round all over; a cube and a cone have corners.

q.t: Heena decorates a cube box: one star on each face and one pompom on each corner. How many stars and pompoms in all?
q.e: 6 faces need 6 stars and 8 corners need 8 pompoms: 6 + 8 = 14.

q.t: Atif puts one ribbon on every edge of a cuboid and one star on every face. How many ribbons and stars together?
q.e: 12 edges need 12 ribbons and 6 faces need 6 stars: 12 + 6 = 18.

q.t: Stars cost ₹2 each. How much do you pay for one star on every face of a cube?
q.e: A cube has 6 faces, so 6 stars: 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 12 rupees.

q.t: Who am I? I have no corners. I have 2 flat faces. I can roll.
q.e: A sphere has no flat faces, a cone has a corner and a cuboid has corners — only a cylinder fits.

q.t: Who am I? I have 1 corner and 1 flat face.
q.e: A cone has one pointed corner and one flat round base.

q.t: Who am I? I have 8 corners, and my faces are rectangles that are not all the same.
q.e: 8 corners means a box. If the faces are not all the same square, it is a cuboid, not a cube.

q.t: How many corners do 3 cones and 2 spheres have together?
q.e: Each cone has 1 corner (3 in all) and spheres have none: 3 + 0 = 3.

q.t: Count all the corners of one cube, one cuboid and one cylinder.
q.e: Cube 8, cuboid 8, cylinder 0: 8 + 8 + 0 = 16.

q.t: Riya is stacking shapes. On which shape is it hardest to balance another shape?
o: A cylinder standing on its flat end
q.e: A sphere has no flat face on top, so things slide off it.

q.t: A box has 12 edges. Ribbons come in packs of 5. How many packs must you buy to have a ribbon for every edge?
q.e: 2 packs give only 10 ribbons, which is short of 12; 3 packs give 15, which is enough.
